Package com.musemo.model

Class VisitorModel

java.lang.Object
com.musemo.model.VisitorModel
public class VisitorModel extends Object
This class is used as a data model for a visitor in the museum. It is designed to encapsulate the data related to a visitor's attributes like name, ID, gender, and type.
